title: EduEVAL-DB: A Role-Based Dataset for Pedagogical Risk Evaluation in Educational Explanations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM-generated instructional explanations using a pedagogical risk rubric to detect the reinforcement of stereotypes, exclusionary narratives, or dominant cultural values. The methodology involves semi-automatic annotation with expert teacher review to create binary risk labels, which are then used to benchmark and fine-tune LLM-based pedagogical evaluators via zero-shot prompting.
